## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue, if any.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and their results. Include a screenshot for visible UI
changes or a reproducible example for calculation changes. State any checks that
remain unverified.

## Release and data impact

Describe changes to calculation rules, retained reports, release selection, or
deployment requirements when relevant. Keep credentials, working databases,
downloaded disclosures, and generated personal reports out of the pull request.
